# greenhorn

> A Claude Code plugin that rewrites technical text for a reader who is new to your system. A read-only agent finds where a newcomer gets lost, Claude answers each gap from your code, and the rewrite puts one real example first. A fixed checker fails on a circular definition and on a missing example.

greenhorn has two commands: /greenhorn:explain (rewrite) and /greenhorn:test (find stumbles only). A model reader is not a human newcomer. The default limits, such as 5 terms, are untested guesses.

## Install

/plugin marketplace add gagoar/gago-plugins
/plugin install greenhorn@gago-plugins
